semiconductor_relevance: High — DyFlows Technologies specializes in equipment for semiconductor assembly and device handling, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: DyFlows Technologies (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. focuses on manufacturing advanced equipment for semiconductor assembly, including feeding systems, die sorters, and flip chip placement systems. Their commitment to innovation and collaboration positions them as a key supplier for efficient semiconductor production processes.

regional_presence.China: DyFlows Technologies is based in Jiangsu, China, focusing on advancing technology in the semiconductor equipment sector.
